subject: Request: Evidence package & audit format for GDPR deletion/access
messages:
From: Ingrid Olsen <ingrid.olsen@acme.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: acme-privacy@acme.com
Date: 2028-03-12T09:14:00Z
Subject: Evidence required for user deletion (user id: 9f7c1e)

Hi Diego,

Per our data subject rights intake, Acme has received a verified deletion request for user id 9f7c1e (email: jana.brooks@acme.com). To complete our audit we need: 
- A signed confirmation that the user’s profile and associated tokens have been purged from Redwood production and backups.
- An export of the audit-log entries related to that subject (creation, access, modification, deletion) in a machine-readable format (CSV or JSON) with timestamps in ISO8601.
- A short description of whether Redwood acted as controller or processor for any of the processing activities tied to this user, and a copy of the deletion order you executed.

Can you confirm what format you can provide and an ETA? Our compliance team is aiming to close the request this week and needs the proof bundled into our records.

Thanks,
Ingrid Olsen
Senior Counsel, Privacy
Acme Corp

--
Acme Corp legal contact: acme-privacy@acme.com

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Ingrid Olsen <ingrid.olsen@acme.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-12T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence required for user deletion (user id: 9f7c1e)

Hi Ingrid — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha (Privacy), Markus (Compliance) and Lauren (Legal) to assemble the evidence package and confirm roles. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Format: we can provide both a CSV audit extract and a human-readable PDF confirmation. Draft CSV specification attached.
- Proof of deletion: we will provide a signed statement + cryptographic hash of the exported deletion dump for your records.
- Controller/processor: Redwood acted as processor for hosted inference (we processed requests on behalf of Acme). We will include the short role statement and reference to the DPA/SCCs in the annex.

Neha / Markus / Lauren — can you confirm the extract will include the following columns: event_ts (ISO8601), actor_id, actor_role, action, resource_id, resource_type, request_id, origin_ip? Also confirm whether we should include backup retention cutover timestamps (we have a 30-day rolling backup window; deletions are scrubbed per our retention policy — include that text in the confirmation).

ETA: If we can get confirmation today, we should be able to deliver the package (CSV + signed PDF) by end of day 2028-03-15.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, Ingrid Olsen <ingrid.olsen@acme.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-13T08:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence required for user deletion (user id: 9f7c1e)

On Mon, Mar 12, 2028 at 11:02, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai wrote:
> Diego: looped us in — details below.

Hi all — thanks Diego and Ingrid. Confirming scope and providing the deliverable format below. Attachments: gdpr_deletion_proof_template.csv (sample rows), audit-log-extract-spec.md (field defs). Also uploaded a working folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink

Deliverable components we will produce: 
1) Deletion Confirmation PDF (signed): includes user id, email hash, processing role (Redwood = processor for hosted inference endpoints), DPA reference, and backup retention statement.
2) Audit-log extract (CSV): columns as requested and agreed: event_ts, actor_id, actor_role, action, resource_id, resource_type, request_id, origin_ip, request_payload_ref.
3) Deletion action manifest (CSV): list of internal artifacts we removed (profile record id, KV-cache keys evicted, model-context pointers) — for internal traceability.
4) Metadata: job run id, storage shard id, and SHA256 of the exported CSV (included in the signed PDF).

Notes / constraints: 
- Backups: production incremental backups are retained for up to 30 days; we can provide the window and confirmation that within that window deletions are scheduled and the background scrub has been executed for the subject. For long-term cold backups (snapshot archives older than 90 days) we will provide the retention policy and the ticket to schedule manual purging if Acme requests it (this is an elevated ops request).
- Redaction: we will not include sensitive payload contents in the CSV; payloads will be referenced via request_payload_ref (internal pointer) and can be exported under a separate secure transfer if required by a DPA.

Action items: 
- Diego: confirm Acme is comfortable with (a) CSV extract + signed PDF + manifest, and (b) we reference retention policy rather than purging cold snapshots unless Acme requests manual purge.
- Lauren / Markus: please review attachments for legal/compliance language to ensure we provide the proper controller/processor wording and signature block.

ETA: target delivery 2028-03-15 EOD.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, Ingrid Olsen <ingrid.olsen@acme.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-14T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence required for user deletion (user id: 9f7c1e)

On Tue, Mar 13, 2028 at 08:21, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai wrote:
> Draft components and notes.

All good from security. Two clarifications we added to audit-log-extract-spec.md (attached):
- We will include an anonymized actor mapping table (actor_id -> role) rather than raw internal usernames for least-privilege disclosure. That keeps the audit useful but minimizes internal exposure.
- For backup confirmation we will include the scrub job run id and the job log excerpt (redacted), not raw backup files. If Acme needs full-proof purging of archived snapshots >90 days we require formal change control — we can initiate on approval.

Lauren — can you confirm the short controller/processor phrasing I propose below will be acceptable for Acme compliance bundle? I propose: 

"Redwood Inference acted as a processor for requests received via Acme-controlled API keys for the subject user. Redwood processed data on behalf of Acme per the Data Processing Agreement dated 2026-09-01 and the Standard Contractual Clauses adopted between parties. Redwood did not determine the purposes and means of processing for the subject record."

If that phrasing is good, we'll include it in the signed PDF.

-Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Ingrid Olsen <ingrid.olsen@acme.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: acme-privacy@acme.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-15T16:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Evidence required for user deletion (user id: 9f7c1e)

Thanks everyone — that format works for Acme. A couple of small asks before you finalize: 
- Please include the ISO8601 timestamps in UTC and a short note about timezones.
- In the signed PDF, add a single line that references the DPA and the SCCs by date (we have the 2026-09-01 DPA reference).
- For the anonymized actor mapping table, include a brief legend (e.g., AI-001 = inference service, OP-007 = ops cleanup job).

If you can deliver the package by EOD today (2028-03-15) we will close the subject rights ticket on our side.

Ingrid Olsen
Senior Counsel, Privacy
Acme Corp
